rate_limit_windows_start_aligned.name: rate_limit_windows_start_aligned
rate_limit_windows_start_aligned.value: date_trunc("rate_limit_windows"."window_kind", "rate_limit_windows"."window_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = "rate_limit_windows"."window_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

request_events_legal.name: request_events_legal
request_events_legal.value:
("request_events"."from_status" IS NULL AND "request_events"."to_status" = 'sent' AND "request_events"."actor" = 'principal')
        OR ("request_events"."from_status", "request_events"."to_status", "request_events"."actor") IN (('sent', 'accepted', 'participant'), ('sent', 'declined', 'participant'), ('sent', 'cancelled', 'principal'), ('sent', 'expired', 'platform'), ('accepted', 'answered', 'participant'), ('accepted', 'cancelled', 'principal'), ('accepted', 'expired', 'platform'))

requests_lane_coherent.name: requests_lane_coherent
requests_lane_coherent.value:
CASE WHEN "requests"."lane" = 'free' THEN "requests"."free_lane" IS NOT NULL AND "requests"."bid_minor" = 0
          ELSE "requests"."free_lane" IS NULL AND "requests"."bid_minor" > 0 END

requests_cleared.name: requests_cleared
requests_cleared.value: "requests"."cleared_minor" IS NULL OR ("requests"."status" = 'answered' AND "requests"."cleared_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "requests"."bid_minor")

rules_quiet_hours_complete.name: rules_quiet_hours_complete
rules_quiet_hours_complete.value: ("rules"."quiet_start" IS NULL) = ("rules"."quiet_end" IS NULL) AND ("rules"."quiet_start" IS NULL) = ("rules"."quiet_time_zone" IS NULL)

signing_keys_status_times.name: signing_keys_status_times
signing_keys_status_times.value:
CASE "signing_keys"."status"
        WHEN 'active' THEN "signing_keys"."rotated_at" IS NULL AND "signing_keys"."revoked_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'rotated' THEN "signing_keys"."rotated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "signing_keys"."revoked_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'revoked' THEN "signing_keys"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
      END
